questions.question: Where was Maria born?
questions.explanation: Warsaw, the year 1867 — the Skłodowski family.

questions.question: Why does Maria lose her faith in God?
questions.explanation: After her mother dies of tuberculosis she stops believing.

questions.question: How does Maria get to the Sorbonne?
answers: She works and supports her sister Bronia
She receives a scholarship from the tsar
She travels with her husband Pierre
questions.explanation: She makes a pact with Bronia: first one studies, the other works.

questions.question: What did she name the element in honour of Poland?
questions.explanation: Maria names it Polonium — a tribute to Poland.

questions.question: How many times did Maria win the Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: The Nobel in physics and in chemistry.
